svg.title: Index Translator browser components, transcribing a recording
svg.desc: Open offers an audio or video file when the server can transcribe. The media module reads its tracks. What the server takes (WAV, Ogg Opus, or Opus remuxed from WebM or Matroska) goes as it is; anything else is decoded and re-encoded by the transcode module, as Ogg Opus where the server takes it. The flow posts the recording, reads the stream of segments through the resume module, and rewrites the transcript into the source as SubRip after every segment. re-encoding a recording: public/open-ui.ts → public/transcribe-flow.ts → public/transcode.ts → public/audio-upload.ts → public/ogg-opus.ts.
